name: Strip: remove pasties, patches and body paint
description: Before dressing her, remove the small coverings, patches, pasties and any body paint from the incoming image completely, so that none of them shows through, remains visible or leaves a mark under or around the new outfit. Then apply only what is described below.
notes: Optional line (components.strip) for outfits fed from a Bare_Pasties, Bare_Contoured or Bare_Paint image.
